name: CIS Controls v8 — Implementation Group 1
description: CIS Critical Security Controls v8.1 — Implementation Group 1 (essential cyber hygiene). This is the prioritised top-18 controls list, distinct from the CIS Linux/Windows Benchmarks. Only safeguards mappable to host-level rules are included.

controls.name: Establish and maintain a secure configuration process
controls.desc: All assets follow a hardened configuration baseline: MAC, kernel hardening, disabled legacy protocols, hardened SSH/RDP defaults.

controls.name: Implement and manage a firewall on servers
controls.desc: Host firewall active on all servers and end-user devices.

controls.name: Use unique passwords
controls.desc: Each account uses a unique, complex password subject to length and lockout policies; modern hashing protects stored credentials.

controls.name: Disable dormant accounts
controls.desc: Default and rarely-used accounts must be disabled; built-in Guest off, no extra UID 0.

controls.name: Establish an access-granting process
controls.desc: Privileged access controlled: no shared root, SSH MaxAuthTries limits brute-force, RDP requires Network Level Authentication.

controls.name: Require MFA for administrative access
controls.desc: Strong authentication for administrators — public-key SSH (cryptographically equivalent to MFA factor 'something you have'), password complexity, and lockout.

controls.name: Establish and maintain a vulnerability management process
controls.desc: Track and remediate known vulnerabilities: no Known-Exploited / critical / high CVEs outstanding.

controls.name: Perform automated application patch management
controls.desc: Security patches applied automatically where supported; no patches pending reboot for extended periods.

controls.name: Collect audit logs
controls.desc: Audit subsystem captures security-relevant events on every host.

controls.name: Standardize time synchronization
controls.desc: All systems synchronise to a reliable time source so audit records correlate.

controls.name: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software
controls.desc: Anti-malware enabled with real-time protection and current signatures.

controls.name: Establish and maintain secure network architecture
controls.desc: Network segmentation, no IP forwarding between subnets, ICMP redirect protection, reverse-path filter.

controls.name: Network monitoring and defense
controls.desc: Continuous network monitoring with audit logs, failed-login surveillance and time-synchronised clocks.

controls.name: Encrypt sensitive data in transit
controls.desc: Strong TLS protocols and ciphers, valid certificates, mandatory SMB signing, legacy WDigest credential store off.

controls.name: Encrypt data on end-user devices
controls.desc: Full-disk encryption (BitLocker on Windows / equivalent on Linux) on portable devices.
